'''Turyit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Argullian]] medical supplies merchant who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
After [[Argul]] was [[Battle of Argul|attacked]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began an evacuation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Turyit attempted to bribe [[Melsa Dor]], a crewmember aboard one of the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] involved in the evacuation, to make room on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] for 60 barrels of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] he possessed. He planned to sell the bacta at an inflated price to Argullians injured in the battle. He didn't want the bacta to be commandeered by [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Mozim]], a member of the Argullian government, so he wanted Dor to let him put the bacta an out-of-the-way place. However, they were being watched by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Olge Plavi-Dol]] and [[Wamtra]], so Dor refused to help him. He then tried to persuade the Jedi to let him have it on the ship, by claiming that the barrels contained a variety of wine from a vineyard that had been destroyed in the fighting and that it was the last of that variety of [[Alcohol/Legends|wine]] in existence in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
